deterministic.reason: Every hosts-sync passage is in the diff with no untouched sibling line.
All reportHostsSync and createProxyServer callers are in changed files.
No unregistered persistent artifact is introduced.
cli-utils.ts writes no new state artifact, so clean-utils.ts is unaffected.
500ms bounds only the HTTP capability response; 3.5s intentionally clears the daemon's 3s watcher fallback; process-management timeouts cannot delay hosts sync.
The tlds accessor is too broad for LAN inference; every actual tlds.includes("local") inference was removed and verified by search.
Six independent mutations for authority matching, later aliases, .local skipping, absent handling, LAN inference, and disabled mapping each failed the intended assertion and were restored green.

exemptions.evidence: The guarded endpoint and hosts-file observation create no persistent state artifact.

exemptions.claim: Larger process-management timeouts do not invalidate the hosts-sync ceilings
exemptions.evidence: They are not on the producer path for the endpoint response or route-watcher write.
